payload.title: [auth-core-6] Signup returns distinct 409 for already-registered email (account enumeration)
payload.description:
AUDIT FINDING auth-core-6 (low/security, confidence=high, verify-votes +2/-0)

FILE: apps/server/src/auth/identity-routes.ts
LINES: 1339-1348

WHAT: handleEmailSignup returns 409 email_already_registered (L1346) when the email already has a User row, versus a 200 success otherwise. This is a definitive existence oracle for any email, and the route is also unthrottled (auth-core-1), so it can be probed at scale. Together with the login timing oracle (auth-core-2) it gives a clean, cheap enumeration surface.

IMPACT: Reliable enumeration of which email addresses already have accounts.

SUGGESTED FIX: Either accept the standard signup-enumeration tradeoff explicitly, or move to a verify-by-email flow that returns a uniform 200 and only sends a 'you already have an account' email out-of-band; at minimum throttle the endpoint.
